name: spay.sdk.utils.receiver.OtpReceiver
description: YooMoney's YooKassa SPay flow listens for Google's SMS verification event. When Google offers an SMS consent prompt, this Receiver opens it so the user can share a one-time payment code.
disableEffect: The SPay flow cannot use Google's SMS consent step to receive a one-time code, so verification that depends on it may not complete.
